verses.text: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.

xrefs.text: Lift up your eyes on high: Who created all these? He leads forth the starry host by number; He calls each one by name. Because of His great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—

verses.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.

xrefs.text: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.

verses.text: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.

the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.

He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.

verses.text: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.

xrefs.text: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.

He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.

verses.text: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
